english.title: Person in charge of wind turbine generator fail to repair or replace failed light
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person in charge of a wind turbine generator at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), failed, on the failure of a light which was required by article 223 of the Air Navigation Order 2016 to be displayed by night, to repair or replace the light as soon as reasonably practicable
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 223(7) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
